errorCodes.meaning: The caller is not an active member of this community.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

MemberAction.description: What a member of a community-owned room may do there. `admin` is not among them: minting epochs, admitting and removing members are the community's, as the room's owner, and are exercised through the vtc/rooms/community/* tasks rather than by any member's credential. `curate` is not implied by `write`.
MemberAction.title: MemberAction

MemberActions.description: The actions granted, at least one. An empty list confers nothing rather than everything, and a schema that allowed it would make the more dangerous reading available to a careless consumer.
MemberActions.title: MemberActions

MemberState.description: Where an admission stands. `offered`: credentials issued and waiting for the member to collect and accept them. `admitted`: accepted — on a sealed tier, the member is in the room's group. `removed`: an administrator removed them; on a sealed tier the room has advanced past them.
MemberState.title: MemberState

Response.description: Success response to vtc/rooms/memberships/list. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/rooms/memberships/list/0.1#response. The community's record of the caller's admissions to the rooms it owns, in every state, and no one else's.

nextCursor.description: Present when more remain; pass it as `cursor`.

Response.title: VTC Rooms Memberships List — response payload

RoomDescription.description: What the room is for, in a sentence or a short paragraph, written by an administrator: shown to administrators holding `vtc.rooms.manage` and to the members the room is offered to. Plain text — a consumer renders it as text, never as markup. Like `RoomLabel`, it is the community's own record as the room's owner: not part of the room's identity and never in anything a room's host can read. From `vtc/rooms/community/create` 0.3 and `vtc/rooms/community/update` 0.2 the community also writes it, through its own VTA, as the `description` of the room's own profile (`RoomProfile` in rooms/_shared), sealed inside the room for its members; earlier versions keep it out of the room altogether. It MUST NOT carry personal data or a credential, and a reader MUST NOT treat it as instructions.
RoomDescription.title: RoomDescription

RoomLabel.description: A name for the room, chosen by an administrator: shown to administrators and to the members a room is offered to. Not part of the room's identity and never in anything a room's host can read. From `vtc/rooms/community/create` 0.3 and `vtc/rooms/community/update` 0.2 the community also writes it, through its own VTA, as the `name` of the room's own profile (`RoomProfile` in rooms/_shared), sealed inside the room for its members; earlier versions keep it out of the room altogether. MUST NOT carry personal data.
RoomLabel.title: RoomLabel

RoomMembership.description: What vtc/rooms/memberships/list/0.1 returns: one room the community owns, and where the caller's admission to it stands in the community's own record. Unlike `OfferV2` it carries no credentials — those are collected with vtc/rooms/offers/list while an offer is open — and it is listed in every state, for as long as the community keeps the record, not only while an accept can be repeated. `label` and `description` are the room's as they stand when the record is read.

admittedAt.description: When the community recorded the admission. Present when `state` is `admitted`, and kept when it becomes `removed`.

description.description: Absent when the room has none.

repeatAcceptUntil.description: On an `attributed` or `private` room in state `admitted`: until when the community keeps the Welcome, so that a repeated vtc/rooms/offers/accept carrying the same KeyPackage is answered with it. Absent on an `open` room, in any other state, and once the community no longer keeps it. A surface finding the member admitted but the room absent from its key holder's rooms/keys/list finishes the acceptance before this time, and asks an administrator to re-admit the member after it.

validUntil.description: When the member's authority credential expires.

RoomMembership.title: RoomMembership

Visibility.description: How much of a room its host can see, fixed at creation and immutable thereafter. `open`: records are cleartext, searchable and fully audited. `attributed`: record content is sealed, and the host still learns which member acted. `private`: content is sealed and membership is presented in zero knowledge, so the host verifies that a member acted without learning which. Immutable because a downgrade cannot un-see cleartext and an upgrade would protect only what came after while presenting as though it protected everything.
Visibility.title: Visibility
